elements.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: seamless DAMAGED-IDLE animation sprite sheet for an existing hand-painted 2D game. The reference image contains TWO already approved damage appearances: LEFT is damage stage 1 (after first non-weakness hit), RIGHT is damage stage 2 (after second non-weakness hit). Preserve those exact item identities, materials, colors, outlines, silhouettes and damage patterns. Create ONLY recurring idle motions within each damaged appearance. IMPORTANT: This is NOT a destruction progression, NOT a transition between damage levels, and NOT a disappearing effect. The item remains visibly present and at the same damage level forever until another attack. Output exactly SIXTEEN isolated frames in a regular 4-column by 4-row grid, square canvas ideally 2048x2048, transparent real-alpha background. Frames in cells 0-7 (first TWO rows, left to right) are one complete eight-frame loop of reference LEFT. Frames in cells 8-15 (last TWO rows) are a separate eight-frame loop of reference RIGHT. Fixed 512x512 equivalent cells with identical bottom-center anchor and object scale; no frame-dependent resizing, no camera movement, no panels, no grid lines, no shadows, no numbers, no labels, no text, no orbs. Each object occupies around 75% of cell width/height with clear padding; objects do not touch cell boundaries. The last frame in each group must naturally join its first. Keep all non-animated body pixels as identical as possible across all eight frames in that group. Constraints: Do not introduce any additional damage over time, do not break anything apart, do not restore/rebuild damage, do not fade the object out, do not generate an orb, no opaque white background or checkerboard. Motion requirement: ONLY the water surface ripples and highlights move inside the exposed water, and heavy-state leak droplets travel down and restart. Blue jar, handles, cream rim, cracks and missing rim pieces stay absolutely fixed.
